description: Fibocom L830-EB (Intel XMM 7262, the laptops' M.2 LTE card) in its USB MBIM composition with CDC-ACM ports: ModemManager owns it as the rest of the family (MBIM), AT on ttyACM0 in the historical observation (the imported catalog: AT and SMS on ttyACM0). The family's XMM dialect is assumed for its radio, not confirmed on this older chip: an AT+XACT or AT+XLEC the modem refuses only hides that view. No field report in our sources (ALPHA1.md 0.1, HANDOFF 236)
